# The Python packages the suite image installs, each pinned to one version and the hashes of its files, so that pip
# installs exactly these files and nothing else. Playwright stays at the base image's version so that the browsers the
# image ships match it. To change a version, regenerate this file inside the base image with pip-compile from
# pip-tools, from a file that holds the single line playwright==<version>:
#   pip-compile --generate-hashes --no-header --allow-unsafe --output-file=suite-requirements.txt <that file>
